text: Harbour City builds patiently from their own half, with the ball moving through central midfielders on the left side of the center circle. Marek Barros plays a sharp through pass towards Elias Okafor, who is positioned about 14 metres from Seabrook Town’s goal on the left flank of the attacking third. Okafor controls the ball and shoots confidently with his foot, scoring to put Harbour City ahead 1-0 just before halftime. The goal comes after nearly a minute of careful, short passing involving 17 passes that break down the Seabrook Town defense.
